svg.title: Notifications for finance events: claims submitted, decided and paid — SoftTrack web design mockup (#292)
svg.desc: Two people submitted expense claims and the finance admin approved one, and none of the three was told anything: every notification SoftTrack sends is about a ticket. Finance admins are told when a claim is submitted or a run awaits approval, the claimant when a claim is approved, refused or reimbursed, and no notification carries an amount.
